scope: Publication of already-completed controlled production SDK wire/digest reproduction. Tests were not rerun for publication.

sanitization.wireEnvironment: Only HOME, GOCACHE, GOMODCACHE, npm_config_cache with controlled /tmp paths
sanitization.fixtureIdentifiersAndAbsoluteSourcePaths: Non-secret identity/path bindings are preserved because they determine the production command digest.

lifecycleModel: Only check.status and command.status are modeled running from retained unknown status for the Create-time helper comparison.

gitEvidencePreservation..gitignore: Directory-local !*.log preserves the manifest-bound test log in normal staging.
gitEvidencePreservation..gitattributes: ** -text preserves evidence bytes across platforms; go-test.log -whitespace preserves raw output.
